project.title: DevOps & AWS Development

parentsummary.deliverables: Designed, developed, and maintained cloud-native analytics applications for Agriculture Canada's Analytics team, delivering IaC development using AWS CDK v1/v2, AWS CodePipeline-based CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps security and governance reporting with automated code and IaC scanning via Checkov, Terrascan, SonarQube, and JFROG Artifactory integration, and continuous improvement of deployment practices and release management.
parentsummary.outcomes: Delivered a secure, cloud-native analytics platform on AWS supporting Agriculture Canada's departmental data analysis requirements, with a comprehensive DevSecOps pipeline providing automated security scanning and supply chain management enabling consistent, compliant, and auditable deployments.

challenge.summary: The Analytics team is focused on designing, developing and deploying applications for data analysis that operate in the AWS Cloud to meet departmental analytical requirements provided data.

deliverables: Needs analysis, define requirements, and strategize architecture with AWS team
Architectural design and Proof of Concept (PoC) implementation for design review sessions
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Coding and review
CI/CD Pipelines - AWS CodeCommit, AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeBuild, AWS CodeDeploy
Implementation and maintenance of CI/CD AWS Resources meeting best practices and agile deployment
Security and Governance reporting on Code and IaC to support DevSecOps compliance
Continuous improvement of Deployment Practices and Release Management

outcomes: ✅ Delivered critical analytics platform supporting analytics operations through AWS cloud-native architecture for client workload systems
✅ Implemented comprehensive DevSecOps pipeline with automated security scanning and supply chain management, enabling secure data analysis capabilities

items: Amazon AWS (AWS CDK v1/v2, AWS CodeCommit, AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeBuild, AWS CodeDeploy, AWS Cloud9, AWS Glue, AWS DMS, AWS Lambda)
